results.title: Public schools, college across Palm Beaches, Treasure Coast to reopen after flooding
results.description: Public schools in Palm Beaches and the Treasure Coast will reopen on Monday, Nov. 9, following closures caused by historic flooding.

results.title: Man arrested outside of LeBron James' home, accused of stalking Sixers star
results.description: A man was arrested outside of LeBron James' home in Los Angeles, accused of stalking the Sixers star. He was caught on surveillance cameras in Brentwood Friday night and security called police. Officers say the man claimed to be LeBron's son. James was not home at the time. He was in Cleveland for the Sixers game against the Cavaliers.(Photo: Nick Cammett / Getty Images)
